args.sql:
SELECT 
    s.supplyregistry,
    s.resourceinventory->'power'->>'generators' AS power_generators,
    s.resourceinventory->'essentials'->>'water_liters' AS water_liters,
    t.totaldeliverytons,
    d.hubcaptons,
    t.deliverysuccessrate,
    t.vehiclebreakrate,
    (t.totaldeliverytons / d.hubcaptons) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate/100.0) * 100 AS lpm
FROM supplies s
JOIN transportation t ON s.supplyregistry = t.transportsupref
JOIN distributionhubs d ON t.transporthubref = d.hubregistry
WHERE (t.totaldeliverytons / d.hubcaptons) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate/100.0) * 100 < 500
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    s.supplyregistry,
    s.resourceinventory->'power'->>'generators' AS power_generators,
    s.resourceinventory->'essentials'->>'water_liters' AS water_liters
FROM supplies s
JOIN transportation t ON s.supplyregistry = t.transportsupref
JOIN distributionhubs d ON t.transporthubref = d.hubregistry
WHERE (CAST(t.totaldeliverytons AS numeric) / CAST(d.hubcaptons AS numeric)) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate/100.0) * 100 < 500;
